# Spotify answers seen on a real account in Development Mode (2026-10-24), as the helper reports them.
artist --limit 11 or more   -> {"error":{"code":"api_error","message":"Spotify answered HTTP 400: Invalid limit"}}
artist --limit 1..10        -> ok (total releases 33 for the artist tried; offset 10 gives the next page)
album --limit 50            -> ok
playlist --limit 50 (own)   -> ok
playlist of another user    -> exit 0, tracks_available false, total 0, tracks [] (metadata only)
playlist 37i9dQZF1DX... (Spotify-made editorial) -> {"error":{"code":"api_error","message":"Spotify answered HTTP 404: Resource not found"}}

# Listening history (2026-10-24, after login with user-read-recently-played and user-top-read)
recent --limit 5 / 50            -> ok; the same track can repeat (38 distinct tracks in 50 plays)
recent --before <cursors.before> -> ok; strictly older plays; cursors.before moves back
recent --after <cursors.after>   -> ok; 0 plays, both cursors null when nothing is newer
top tracks / top artists, limit 50, any offset up to the total -> ok (totals: tracks 2039 medium, 547 short; artists 164 long, 140 medium)
a token without the scope        -> scopes_missing before any request (helper-side check)
